Connections as text
  • Visitor browser session to Edge cache (HTTPS)
  • Edge cache to Web app (origin fetch)
  • Web app to Public API gateway (REST calls)
  • Public API gateway to Primary database (SQL)
  • Public API gateway to Job queue (enqueue)
  • Job queue to Primary database (writes)
  • CI pipeline to Web app (deploy)
  • Web app to Monitoring (traces)
